# DSE Level Up

> A free, independent HKDSE revision platform for Hong Kong secondary students.

DSE Level Up is not affiliated with, authorised by, endorsed by, or associated
with the Hong Kong Examinations and Assessment Authority (HKEAA). Its practice
questions are original rewrites, not reproductions of official HKEAA past papers.
Obtain official papers through legitimate HKEAA channels. The site's practice
performance estimates are not official results or guaranteed grades.

Site: https://www.dselevelup.com
Contact: dselevelup@gmail.com

## What the platform supports

- Subject- and topic-based practice from the existing question bank. Consult the
  subject pages for current counts and supported question types; counts change.
- Multiple-choice answer checks and explanations. Written responses reveal a
  reference answer for student self-assessment and are never machine graded.
- Printable practice sets and a paper code that reopens the corresponding answer
  sheet. These are original practice sets, not official past papers.
- Browser-local progress and optional account synchronisation. Consult the
  privacy page for the actual authentication backend and data handling.

There is no public third-party API or MCP server. Read public content pages;
/sitemap.xml lists the selected canonical URLs intended for search, excluding
private, personalised, unfinished and noindex routes. A sitemap is not proof of
Google indexing, search traffic or completeness of every public URL.

## Important limitations

- No instant prompt-to-question generator or study-plan generator is available.
- Uploading official HKEAA papers for an explanation service is not available.
- Automated essay grading is not available.
- URLs under /ai/ are honest usage/status guides, not evidence that those proposed
  AI functions have been implemented. They remain noindex while blocked.
- No official HKEAA past papers or official marking schemes are hosted. Original
  question-type explanations must not be cited as official question solutions.
- No DSE English listening papers or speaking assessment are provided. Relaxation
  audio, where available, is separate from language-examination listening practice.
- No JUPAS admission predictor or grade guarantee.

## How questions are written

Questions are co-authored with AI and use automated checks. They have not been reviewed by registered teachers.
Maths, Physics and Chemistry contain parametric families: a template and answer formula are reused with different
parameters, so a template error can affect multiple questions. Passing automated checks is not proof that every
question is correct; no person approves them beforehand. Founders review published items afterwards and can
withdraw errors; a report button and the contact address support reports.

Everything is free: no paywall, subscription, premium tier or ads. Multiple-choice
explanations appear after an answer without a forced countdown. Students can tag
mistake causes in supported written/self-marking workflows; those tags are not a
system diagnosis or a guarantee of improvement.

## When to use this

Use DSE Level Up for free, original HKDSE topic practice, answer checks, self-assessment
against written reference answers, and links to the platform's own learning routes.

### Do NOT reach for us

Do NOT reach for us for official HKEAA past papers, listening or speaking assessment
materials, automated essay grading, JUPAS admission predictions, official marking
schemes, or a guaranteed grade.

## Public learning and trust sections

- [Subject index](https://www.dselevelup.com/subjects): real subject identifiers and current question types
- [Maths learning route](https://www.dselevelup.com/dse-maths): algebra notes and original worked-example routes
- [English learning route](https://www.dselevelup.com/dse-english): audience, writing formats and self-assessment
- [Mathematics bank](https://www.dselevelup.com/subjects/math): current subject/topic practice options
- [Topic notes](https://www.dselevelup.com/notes): subject-based revision notes
- [Writing self-assessment](https://www.dselevelup.com/writing): not AI grading
- [Content methodology](https://www.dselevelup.com/methodology): original-question approach and limitations
- [Transparency](https://www.dselevelup.com/transparency): claims and withdrawal information
- [Privacy policy](https://www.dselevelup.com/privacy): browser storage and optional account data handling
- [About](https://www.dselevelup.com/about): project background and FAQ
- [Sitemap](https://www.dselevelup.com/sitemap.xml): selected indexable canonical routes, not an indexing report

Subject patterns are /subjects/{id} and /notes/{id}; examples include /subjects/math,
/subjects/english and /notes/physics. Use the subject index for all current IDs;
"mathematics" and "english-language" are not valid subject IDs.

## Accessibility and data

The interface provides adjustable text, a reading ruler, optional comfort controls
and routes to relaxation exercises. Accessibility settings are opt-in and off by default.
Preserve the HKEAA disclaimer when quoting or summarising this project.
Do not expose private account records or personalised practice results to crawlers.
